text: Microsoft consolidated revenue for fiscal year 2025 was USD 281.7 billion, a 15% year-over-year increase.
Microsoft consolidated operating income (operating profit) for fiscal year 2025 was USD 128.5 billion, up 17% year over year.
Microsoft reported net income of USD 101,832 million in fiscal year 2025, compared with USD 88,136 million in fiscal year 2024.
Financial risk: spending on cloud and AI infrastructure can raise operating costs and reduce operating margins. Datacenter expansion also depends on energy, land, servers and networking supplies.
Business risk: software and cloud markets are highly competitive, and global economic and geopolitical conditions influence demand.
Income taxes paid, after refunds, amounted to USD 28.7 billion for fiscal year 2025, USD 23.4 billion for 2024 and USD 23.1 billion for 2023.
